scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=atlas-backend && npm run build --workspace=@atlas/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start --workspace=atlas-backend" "npm run start --workspace=@atlas/frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=atlas-backend && node --test tests/server.test.js && node --test archive/vanilla-frontend/tests/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --workspace=atlas-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@atlas/frontend && prettier --check frontend backend/server.js tests docs/architecture.md docs/backend-plan.md README.md package.json playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend backend/server.js tests docs/architecture.md docs/backend-plan.md README.md package.json playwright.config.ts
